description:
Link 👉 https://lnkd.in/g7UgxgSK

I started working in this company ICICI Lombard  from  21st  December 2022 . However , I've been struggling with how to address discriminatory workplace issues that I find disturbing.

I am trying to point out the problems below -


1 . Distance from my house to the Kharagpur branch is only about 45 kms. But the branch manager forced me to rent a house in a local place which I did not want even before joining the office and almost every day he was forced to stay late till night to work .

2 . I am trying my best to do the work properly but that time is not being given to me, instead I am being accused of not being able to work , Branch Manager threatened me to quit this job because of some one candidate with him to join this branch .

3. Branch Manager ( Chandra Sekhar Roy ) came forward and tried to physically assault me , and also said that I am everything here, if I don't accept his words, I will be kicked out of the office.

4. Also I Complaining to ICICI Lombard  HR , But they did not help, instead I was Relocated .
Then I resigned without getting any other option .

This situation is affecting my self-esteem and ability to concentrate any work .
My future stepping stone has been disturbed by this .
I shall never think in my dream that such a situation will occur .
